correctness.rationale: TARGET route: explicit signing sigma* (mask 6995) on archived 12v/24e Chvatal edge list with rho<2.57<=2*sqrt(3). Independently replayed inputs/artifacts/certify.py -> VERIFY_OK. Verified: (a) base identity: 4-regular, connected, triangle-free (all edge neighborhoods disjoint), girth-4 witness 0-1-5-4-0, chi=4 by exhaustive 3-color UNSAT plus verified 4-coloring; unsigned numpy spectrum {4,1.56155,1^4,0^2,-1,-2.56155,-3^2} matches MathWorld formula (-3)^2,(1/2(-1-sqrt17)),-1,0^2,1^4,(1/2(-1+sqrt17)),4. (b) charpoly x^12-24x^10+226x^8-1056x^6+2549x^4-2976x^2+1280 via Bareiss at 13 nodes + exact Fraction interpolation, re-verified at 3 fresh nodes, Newton p2=48=2*24, Cayley-Hamilton zero matrix over ZZ; even polynomial so spectrum symmetric and rho=max|eig|. (c) LDL leg: M=33I-5A^2 exact integer; rational LDL all 12 pivots >0 (min 224/323), so eig(A^2)<33/5=6.6 and rho<sqrt(6.6)~2.569<2.57; 33/5<12 over ZZ gives rho<2*sqrt(3), margin ~0.9, no straddle. (d) Sturm leg: exact Sturm sequence gives 0 roots on [257/100,inf) and (-inf,-257/100]; 257^2*5=330245>330000=100^2*33 certifies 257/100>sqrt(33/5); chi(2)=-48, chi(3)=8192 brackets a root in (2,3) so signing is nontrivial. numpy cross-check rho~2.5616 consistent and below 2.57. Matching counts (1,24,204,752,1175,628,52) are log-only, not needed for headline. Proof (exact certificate), not mere experiment: no floating point in certificate steps.
